heroSub: 10 five-star Koh Samui resorts we've reviewed in depth — all-villa pool resorts on the hillside above Lamai bay where every villa has its own infinity pool, a private-bay eco resort running since 1987, a design hotel on Chaweng famous for its red pool, a family resort with a winding lazy-river pool, and villas spread through a 23-acre garden. From about ฿3,500–18,000/night.
heroStats: 🏝️ 10 five-star resorts — Chaweng · Bophut · Choeng Mon · Lamai · Maenam
introH2: 🏝️ What are Koh Samui's 5-star hotels like, and which zone should you stay in?
introHtml: Koh Samui built its name on beachfront resorts and pool villas over several decades, and its 5-star tier has more range than most people expect — from all-villa pool resorts on the hillside above Lamai bay where every villa has its own infinity pool, to an eco resort on a private bay that has kept its original trees since 1987, to a design hotel on Chaweng whose red pool became the island's postcard image · The thing that really shapes a Samui trip is the zone — Chaweng is the main, liveliest beach where you can walk to restaurants and bars; Bophut / Fisherman's Village is a charming old village; Choeng Mon is a quiet bay near the airport; Lamai has both soft sand and rocky coves; and Maenam up north is the quietest and most private · Book the wrong zone and the whole mood changes — you wanted to walk out to dinner every evening but ended up on a headland that needs a car every time, or brought a toddler to a design boutique with no kids' club · This guide gathers 10 five-star Koh Samui resorts we've reviewed in depth, ranked on real scores, review volume and each one's standout factor — all built from reading real guest reviews, with the good and the honest caveats spelled out, prices compared across 3 booking sites, and direct links to book
mrtHtml: Koh Samui has no rail transit — you'll get around by taxi, rental car, motorbike, Grab, or hotel transfer · Samui Airport (USM) sits on the north of the island near Bophut and Choeng Mon, and many resorts in this guide are only 10–20 minutes away · The zones in this guide: Chaweng Beach — the longest, liveliest main beach, walkable to restaurants and bars (Centara Reserve, SALA, The Library) · Bophut / Fisherman's Village — a charming old village with a walking-street of shops and bars (Hansar) · Choeng Mon — a quiet bay near the airport, shallow water good for families (Garrya Tongsai Bay, Meliá) · Lamai Beach — the island's second-biggest beach, with both soft sand and rocky coves (Banyan Tree, Rocky's) · Maenam Beach — up north, the quietest and most private, about 30 minutes from Chaweng nightlife (W Koh Samui, Santiburi) · The hillside resorts (Banyan Tree, W, Garrya) have steep paths and rely on buggies — not ideal if walking is hard, so ask for a villa near the lobby when you book

entries.type: Luxury Pool Villa Resort 5★ · hillside above Lamai bay
entries.name: Banyan Tree Samui
entries.revCount: Score 9.5 · 147 reviews · 88 villas, every one with a private pool
entries.badge: 🏆 Highest score in this list 9.5 · all pool villas
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Hillside above Lamai Beach · in-resort buggy service
tags: 🏊 Private infinity pool in every villa
entries.addr: 99/9 Moo 4, Maret, Lamai Beach, Koh Samui, Surat Thani
entries.storyHtml: If you had to name one luxury resort that defines modern Samui, it's Banyan Tree Samui — 88 pool villas on a private hillside above Lamai bay, every single one with a private infinity pool angled toward the sea, no non-pool rooms at all. Its 9.5 from 147 reviews is the highest score in this list · Real guests talk about the deep privacy, service where a buggy usually arrives within 4–5 minutes, a private cove with free kayaks and paddleboards, and a Banyan Tree Spa with a Rainforest hydrotherapy circuit some people come for on its own · The honest caveats: the resort is built on a steep hillside with villas stepped up and down, so you lean on buggies constantly; it's quite self-contained, so eating and exploring outside means a drive; and high-season rates climb fast · Best for honeymooners and anyone who wants a fully private pool villa in a genuinely quiet setting
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: To cut down on getting around, ask for a villa near the lobby or beach when you book · Want full sea views — go for the Ocean View Pool Villa · Book low season and rates drop clearly, with more good-view villas available
pros: Private infinity pool in every villa, deeply private
Warm, attentive service — buggies usually arrive within 4–5 minutes (from reviews)
Private cove with free water gear, very quiet
Banyan Tree Spa + Rainforest hydrotherapy · 9.5, top score in this list
cons: Built on a steep hillside — you rely on buggies to get around
Self-contained location — eating and exploring outside means a drive
High-season rates climb fast · some rocks surface at low tide on the cove (from reviews)

entries.type: Luxury Eco Resort 5★ · private bay since 1987
entries.name: Garrya Tongsai Bay Samui
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Choeng Mon private bay · airport ~10 min
tags: 🛁 Bath with a sea view in nearly every room
entries.addr: 84 Moo 5, Choeng Mon, Bophut, Koh Samui, Surat Thani
entries.storyHtml: On a quiet private bay at Choeng Mon sits a resort that was an eco resort before the word caught on in Thailand — Garrya Tongsai Bay Samui, 28 acres that have kept their original trees since opening in 1987. Its signature is "bath with a view": nearly every room has a balcony with a tub facing the bay. Score 9.4 from 410 reviews · Real guests single out the service — staff who remember your name, scoring an exceptional 9.9 in Booking's staff category — plus a clear-water private beach, a breakfast many call one of the best on the island, and a location only about 10 minutes from the airport · The honest caveats: the resort spreads across a wide hillside, so upper rooms mean a walk or a buggy wait; it's a self-contained bay, so heading out means calling a car; and some of the woodwork shows its age · Best for couples who want quiet nature and genuinely warm service
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: To avoid the hill climb, request a Seafront room near the beach and lobby when you book · The entry-level Seaview Hillside Suite already comes with a sea-view tub · Leave time for the spa and a slow beachfront breakfast
pros: Genuinely warm service, staff remember names — 9.9 staff score (from reviews)
Quiet private bay, original trees intact — like a hideaway in coastal forest
Bath with a sea view in nearly every room — hard to find elsewhere
About 10 minutes from Samui Airport · breakfast widely praised
cons: Spread across a wide hillside — some walking up and down, buggies come in waves
Self-contained location — eating and exploring outside means calling a car
Classic styling; some woodwork shows its age (from reviews)

entries.storyHtml: If you want a beachfront 5-star on Chaweng that's still quiet — and reassured by a big review base — Centara Reserve Samui is the answer. It's the first resort in Centara's luxury Reserve collection, fully rebuilt from the old Centara Grand in a colonial-meets-contemporary style, 184 rooms, suites and villas at the calmer north end of Chaweng, just ~13 minutes from the airport. Score 9.3 from 1,265 reviews — the largest review base among these luxury picks · Real guests praise service where staff remember names, a personal Reserve Host in the suites and villas, rooms that look as good as the photos, and 6 restaurants including Act 5 fine dining and Sa-Nga's creative Thai · The honest caveats: it's premium-priced, with value its lowest-scoring category; it's a large family resort that gets busy in high season; and standard-room storage is on the small side · Best for families and couples who want a beachfront 5-star that just works
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For easy pool access, pick the Deluxe Pool Access room · For a personal Reserve Host, step up to a Reserve Pool Suite · If you're packing heavy or staying long, flag storage needs with the resort at booking
pros: Excellent service, staff remember names, personal Reserve Host in suites/villas (from reviews)
Quiet north end of Chaweng, clean pretty beach, airport ~13 min
6 restaurants incl. Act 5 · breakfast and fresh produce praised
Largest review base in this list — 1,265 — reassuring on consistency

entries.addr: 4/1 Moo 1, Maenam, Koh Samui, Surat Thani
entries.storyHtml: On a private headland above Maenam, W Koh Samui is a design pool-villa resort of 74 villas, every one with a private pool, signature W beds, timber decks and either sea or jungle views. Score 9.3 from 270 reviews · The photo the whole island comes to shoot is WOOBAR — the bar's infinity pool that runs out until its edge dissolves into the sea, with a DJ, cocktails and sunset views — plus a much-loved AWAY Spa, a private sand beach, and the Whatever/Whenever service that scores 9.7 in the staff category · The honest caveats: villas are spread across a wide hillside with steps and buggies that sometimes make you wait; the headland is self-contained, so heading out means a car; the north-facing beach is calm and shallow at low tide; and peak-season rates and in-resort F&B run at brand prices · Best for couples and design lovers who want a private pool villa plus a bar-and-sunset scene in-house
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: On a starting budget, the Jungle Oasis Pool Villa is very private with a garden-jungle view · Tell the resort in advance if hills are hard, so they place you near the lobby · Book low season and plan a few meals out to keep the budget in check
pros: Private pool in every villa, spacious and clean, soft W beds (from reviews)

entries.storyHtml: The best-value luxury pick in this list is Rocky's Boutique Resort — a 5-star boutique in the Veranda Collection set on a small cove framed by natural boulders at the south end of Lamai, giving it privacy and a view unlike the resorts along the main sand — from about ฿3,500/night. Score 9.2 from 882 reviews · Real guests praise staff so warm and name-remembering that it earned a Travellers' Choice, two free-form pools facing the bay where the poolside view is the thing people love most, and the seaside fine-dining of The Dining Room · The honest caveats: the beach in front is a rocky cove, not fine sand, so you use the free shuttle to Lamai/Chaweng (only twice a day); the resort steps down a slope with stairs; and some rooms show their age, so ask about the most recently renovated zone · Best for couples who want a romantic luxury feel without top-brand prices
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a private plunge pool by the water, choose Beachfront with Plunge Pool · If you want sandy-beach swimming, plan around the free shuttle or rent a motorbike · Book Premier and up, or ask about the newest-renovated zone, for a fresher room
pros: Best-value luxury here — from ฿3,500, score 9.2 · a Travellers' Choice winner
Quiet private rocky cove, two pretty free-form sea-view pools, big clean rooms

entries.type: Boutique Pool Villa Resort 5★ · on Chaweng Beach
entries.name: SALA Samui Chaweng Beach Resort
entries.revCount: Score 9.1 · 1,715 reviews · beachfront pool villas · 2 Michelin Keys
entries.addr: 99/10 Moo 2, Bo Phut, Chaweng Beach, Koh Samui, Surat Thani
entries.storyHtml: If you love sharp design and a pool villa on Chaweng, SALA Samui Chaweng Beach Resort is the photogenic pick — a 5-star with SALA's signature black-and-white minimalism set against green gardens and the sea. Its Oceanfront Wing sits right on the sand, mostly with private pools, a few steps from the water; it's backed by 2 Michelin Keys and a Travelers' Choice 2025. Score 9.1 from 1,715 reviews — the largest review base in this list · Real guests praise warm, attentive staff, spacious clean rooms and villas, cooked-to-order breakfast, and a beachfront Chaweng location ~15 minutes from the airport · The honest caveats: the cheaper Garden Wing sits across a small road from the beach; in-resort dining and room service run high; and the in-villa pools aren't heated, so they're cold on an evening or in the rain · Best for those who want a photogenic pool villa on a lively beach you can still walk
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: To wake up to the sea and step onto the sand, pay up for the Oceanfront Wing from the start · Eat some meals out — Chaweng's restaurants are ~10 minutes' walk · Use your villa pool during warm daytime hours, since the pools aren't heated
pros: Sharp black-and-white minimalist design, photogenic from every angle · 2 Michelin Keys
Pool villas on Chaweng Beach at a more reachable price than many luxury resorts
Warm staff, the manager looks after guests personally · cooked-to-order breakfast (from reviews)
On Chaweng Beach, airport ~15 min · free kayaks and paddleboards
cons: The cheaper Garden Wing is across a small road from the beach
In-resort dining and room service run fairly high
In-villa pools aren't heated — cold in the evening (from reviews)

entries.storyHtml: The luxury resort that pairs beachfront calm with a walkable village is Hansar Samui Resort & Spa — a right-sized 74-room resort on Bophut Beach where every room is ~50 sqm with a sea view and a big private balcony, teak floors and terrazzo bathrooms, and it's a 2-minute walk to the Fisherman's Village walking street. Score 9.1 from 967 reviews · Real guests put service and staff at the very top — warm and name-remembering — alongside a beachfront saltwater infinity pool, the Luxsa Spa, and seaside dining at H Bistro · The honest caveats: Bophut is a quiet beach where the tide recedes far and there's occasional natural seaweed, not a wide white-sand swimming beach; kids' facilities are limited; the resort has been open for years, so some rooms show wear; and a few room types are open-plan with no fully enclosed bathroom · Best for couples who want beachfront 5-star plus an old-village stroll
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For the closest sea views, choose Sea View and up · Some rooms are open-plan — if you want an enclosed bathroom, ask about the layout and request a recently renovated room · Walk into Fisherman's Village in the evening for more variety and better value than dining in-resort

entries.storyHtml: The most clearly family-designed 5-star in this list is Meliá Koh Samui — the Spanish group's beachfront resort on Choeng Mon. Its signature is a winding, lazy-river-style pool that loops through the whole resort, with many ground-floor rooms opening straight into it (swim-up), plus two-storey Thai-Chinese "boat suites" with private rooftop decks over the bay. Score 9.1 from 1,411 reviews · Real guests love how the winding pool keeps kids busy while parents relax, warm and easy-going staff (9.4 in the staff category), a good-quality varied breakfast, and being just ~10 minutes from the airport, with a kids' pool, mini water park and Kids' Club · The honest caveats: it's a family resort, so it's busy around the pools on holidays and not as quiet as an adults' resort; in-resort F&B is pricey and value is its lowest-scoring category; Choeng Mon is shallow and tidal; and ground-floor pool-access rooms have a poolside walkway people pass along · Best for families who want a luxury beach resort where kids can play all day
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For more quiet, pick THE LEVEL zone or a boat suite with a private rooftop · Ground-floor pool-access rooms get passers-by — choose an upper floor for more privacy · Check the tide times before planning a swim off Choeng Mon beach

entries.storyHtml: For space, privacy and tropical-garden calm, Santiburi Koh Samui delivers on all three — 96 single-storey contemporary-Thai villas and suites spread through a shady 23-acre garden on Maenam Beach in the north of the island, feeling more like a private village than a hotel, with about 300 metres of quiet white-sand private beach and a free-form pool said to be one of the largest on Samui. Score 9.1 from 374 reviews · Real guests praise villas that are big and spotless (9.4 for cleanliness), warm name-remembering staff (9.4 for service), and a fresh buffet breakfast, plus the garden Lén Spa and an 18-hole golf course ~5 minutes away · The honest caveats: Maenam is ~30 minutes from Chaweng nightlife, so not for partygoers; it's a pioneer-era resort in classic Thai style and some villas show their age; villas are spread across a wide garden that takes time to cross; and F&B and spa prices run high · Best for couples and families who want a spacious villa in a quiet garden by a private beach
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For extra privacy, choose the Garden Villa with Plunge Pool · Ask for a recently renovated villa at booking if décor matters to you · Alternate meals between Maenam village and Fisherman's Village to keep F&B costs down

tags: 📚 A real library + iMac in every room

entries.storyHtml: The design resort that's been a Samui postcard for years is The Library — a Member of Design Hotels on central Chaweng Beach, known for the red-mosaic-tiled swimming pool by the sea that plays against its all-white minimalist design, with a genuine library of books and DVDs and an iMac in every room. Score 9.0 from 404 reviews · Real guests love the one-of-a-kind look that photographs beautifully from every angle, a central Chaweng location that walks to restaurants and bars (9.5 for location), spacious comfortable rooms, and The Page beach bar for a sunset cocktail · The honest caveats: it's a small design boutique, not a big family resort with a kids' club; value is its lowest-scoring category (8.5); the all-white rooms are deliberately dim, so reading is hard, and some show their age; and the public beach out front is lively with vendors passing through · Best for design lovers who want a landmark stay in the middle of the action
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For a roomier, comfier stay, choose the ground-floor Executive Suite · If noise wakes you easily, ask for an inner or garden-side room away from the beachfront bars · Want full facilities and a kids' club — look at Centara Reserve or SALA in the same Chaweng area
pros: The red pool and all-white design are one of a kind, photogenic from every angle
Central Chaweng Beach, walk to restaurants and bars (9.5 for location)
Spacious, clean, comfortable rooms · iMac in-room and a real library
The Page beach bar by the sea — great for a sunset cocktail (from reviews)
cons: A small design boutique — no kids' club or big-resort facilities
Value is its lowest-scoring category (8.5) · dim rooms make real reading hard

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate starting rates for standard rooms outside peak season and change by date and season — always check live prices and compare 3 sites before booking · The scores and standout factors here come from reading real guest reviews on booking platforms; we haven't stayed ourselves · Koh Samui's high season (December–March, plus July–August) pushes prices up clearly and the best-view villas fill first, so plan ahead · The hillside resorts (Banyan Tree, W, Garrya) have steep paths and use buggies — not ideal if walking is hard, so ask for a villa near the lobby · Getting around the island is mainly by taxi, rental car or Grab · Article by ThailandAddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — common traveller questions about luxury 5-star hotels in Koh Samui

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best luxury 5-star hotel in Koh Samui?
faq.a: It depends on your style and budget · On score alone, Banyan Tree Samui at 9.5 — all pool villas on the hillside above Lamai bay — is number one in this list · For warm service and quiet nature, Garrya Tongsai Bay at 9.4, a private bay running since 1987 · For beachfront Chaweng with the reassurance of a big review base, Centara Reserve Samui at 9.3 · For a more reachable price that's still luxury, Rocky's Boutique Resort at 9.2 from ฿3,500

faq.q: ❓ How much do luxury 5-star hotels in Koh Samui cost?
faq.a: In this guide, starting rates run about ฿3,500–18,000 per night · The more reachable end is Rocky's from ฿3,500 and Meliá from ฿5,500 · Mid-range is SALA ฿7,500, Hansar ฿8,000, The Library ฿8,500 · The top end is Garrya ฿9,500, Centara Reserve and Santiburi ฿10,000, W ฿14,000 and Banyan Tree ฿18,000 · All are approximate starting rates outside peak; high season (December–March) rises clearly

faq.q: ❓ Which Koh Samui zone should I stay in — Chaweng, Bophut, Choeng Mon, Lamai or Maenam?
faq.a: Chaweng is the lively main beach, walkable to restaurants and bars (Centara Reserve, SALA, The Library) · Bophut / Fisherman's Village is a charming old village with a walking street (Hansar) · Choeng Mon is a quiet bay near the airport with shallow, family-friendly water (Garrya, Meliá) · Lamai is the second-biggest beach, with both soft sand and rocky coves (Banyan Tree, Rocky's) · Maenam up north is the quietest and most private, about 30 minutes from Chaweng nightlife (W, Santiburi)

faq.q: ❓ Which luxury Samui resorts have a private pool in every villa?
faq.a: Every villa comes with a private pool at Banyan Tree Samui (88 villas, sea-view infinity pools) and W Koh Samui (74 villas, all with private pools, on the headland) · SALA Samui and Santiburi offer both pool and non-pool room/villa types, so choose a pool-villa or plunge-pool category at booking if you want a pool in your room

faq.q: ❓ Which luxury Samui resort is best for families, and which for honeymoons?
faq.a: Families: Meliá Koh Samui stands out — a swim-up lazy-river pool, Kids' Club and mini water park · Centara Reserve and Santiburi also have kids' pools / shallow beaches that suit children · Honeymoons / couples: Banyan Tree and W Koh Samui for full private pool villas, Garrya Tongsai Bay and Rocky's for quiet romance · The Library is a design boutique with no kids' club, better for couples than young families

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book, and how do I get around the island?
faq.a: In Samui's high season (December–March and July–August), book 1–2 months ahead, especially for sea-view and pool villas that fill first · In low season, 1–2 weeks is usually enough and prices drop a lot · Getting there: Samui Airport (USM) is on the north near Bophut/Choeng Mon, and many resorts here are just 10–20 minutes away; around the island you'll use taxis, rental cars, motorbikes or Grab · Every platform offers Free Cancellation, so lock a rate early if your plans aren't firm, then compare Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price
